blocks.name: modal
blocks.description: Overlay popup. Modal content is authored as a separate fragment document; links pointing at that path are turned into modal triggers.
blocks.decorate_shape: Exports createModal/openModal helpers; builds a <dialog>, loads the fragment content into it, wires close button, Escape key and backdrop click, and manages focus trapping.
blocks.example_structure: A link whose href is the path of a fragment document holding the modal body
